issue.title: Pytest inherits SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE and fails seven model/provenance assertions
issue.description: At clean sase c9a65d1a58, SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE=sonnet .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_workflow_executor.py::TestShouldHitl tests/main/test_init_skills_deploy.py tests/test_bead/test_sync_checkpoint.py tests/test_commit_workflow_publication_outcomes.py produces 7 failed / 44 passed. Two workflow assertions see sonnet instead of their fixture model; three skills-deploy, one bead checkpoint, and one commit-publication assertion receive an extra SASE_MODEL=claude/sonnet trailer. tests/_conftest_environment.py::_clear_agent_env_vars scrubs SASE_AGENT* and SASE_MODEL_ALIAS_OVERRIDES but omits SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE. Add that ambient override to test isolation while preserving explicit per-test overrides and add a focused isolation regression. This is independent of monitor staging. sase-1pg is not a duplicate: it fixed a fake Popen capturing unrelated git subprocesses; that task remains closed. No active epic has a credible causal link; sase-j7 covers inter-test state leaks rather than this ambient input omission.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The ambient override deterministically selects sonnet and adds a model trailer; the seven nodes match proposing phase evidence. Clearing only SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE provides the control run.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1pj.5.1.2 note #1 and independently reproduced during its landing. The test environment scrub omits the ambient model override, so verification depends on the launching model.

payload.entry: Control run on unchanged c9a65d1a58 with env -u SASE_MODEL_OVERRIDE and the same four pytest selectors: 51 passed in 8.59s. Override run: 7 failed / 44 passed in 12.49s. This isolates the missing ambient-variable scrub.
